lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Ga2Ir2O12 (Sr2GaIrO6) adopts the monoclinic space group C2 (No. 5), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ir and Ga centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside eight-coordinate Sr environments. Corner-sharing is observed between IrO6 and Sr polyhedra, and between GaO6 and IrO6 octahedra, while IrO6 and Sr polyhedra also show edge-sharing. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
